mapper.insert: insert into tb_chat_message (conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, goods_id, content, is_read, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{goodsId}, #{content}, #{isRead}, now())
mapper.select: select m.conversation_id as conversationId, max(m.id) as lastId, max(m.goods_id) as goodsId, count(1) as total from tb_chat_message m where #{userId} in (m.sender_id, m.receiver_id) group by m.conversation_id order by lastId desc limit #{limit}
select id, conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, goods_id, content, is_read, create_time from tb_chat_message where id = #{id}
select count(1) from tb_chat_message where receiver_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
mapper.update: update tb_chat_message set is_read = 1 where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and receiver_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
